description: An elven traveller drifts in at the quiet hour just before dusk, a leather satchel heavy with bound volumes slung at his hip. He is tall and slender, his movements unhurried, and a small inkstain darkens the cuff of his sleeve. He pauses inside the doorway to study the room with the patient attention one might give a difficult passage of text - noting the people, the materials, the rhythm of the place - before approaching you with a courteous nod.
dialogue:
"Forgive the intrusion. I am [event_worker], a scholar lately of the Cordian academies and presently of nowhere in particular."

He inclines his head with quiet courtesy.

"My research has outpaced my patrons, and the road grows tiresome. I require a place where I might earn my keep without trading my mornings to tedium - somewhere alive enough to hold my interest, civilised enough to permit me a desk and a reading lamp. Your establishment came up more than once in conversation. I came to see it for myself."

He lets the silence settle for a moment, watching you with mild, unreadable curiosity.

"I am not strong, but I am useful. I read four languages, balance ledgers in my sleep, and rarely embarrass the people who employ me. What say you?"

choices.option: Offer him a position for [COST] per day. (Potential: Reputation)
choices.message: You extend your hand and offer [COST] per day. [event_worker] considers the gesture for a long moment before accepting it with a careful, measured grip. 'A fair offer, fairly given. I shall begin in the morning.' He bows slightly - more habit than ceremony - and slips back into the dusk. Within a day, two regulars remark on the new face behind your counter and on the elegant precision with which he answers their questions. Word spreads that you welcome learned folk (+5 Reputation).

choices.option: Offer access to your records and a writing desk in exchange for steadier wages. (Potential: Discount, Relationship, Scholar's Joy)
choices.message: You sweeten the arrangement with the use of your private records and a corner desk of his own, settling on [actual_cost] per day. [event_worker]'s composure thaws by a fraction. 'You understand what you are offering. That is rare.' He sets the satchel down by his foot, as though he has decided something. He works at a 20% discount, starts with a stronger bond to you (+18 Relationship), and gains the 'Scholar's Joy' trait for 90 days.

choices.option: Propose a trial month at reduced pay. (Potential: Discount, Trial Worker)
choices.message: You propose a trial month at [actual_cost] per day, with full terms thereafter if both of you remain content. [event_worker] tilts his head a fraction, as if turning the offer over in good light. 'A reasonable test of a reasonable offer. Agreed.' He works at a 25% discount and gains the 'Trial Worker' trait for 30 days.

You explain that you cannot offer him a place at present. [event_worker] receives the news with the same level composure with which he arrived. 'Of course. The town is large and my needs are modest. I shall manage.' He bows once more and lets himself out into the gathering night, leaving behind only the faint scent of old paper.
